top_signals.title: Anthropic partners with London-based private equity firm to launch consultancy arm
top_signals.summary: Anthropic is launching a new AI consultancy business in Europe after partnering with London-based private equity firm Hg, according to reports. The company behind some of the world’s most advanced AI models is expected to launch its consultancy firm by the end of the year, the Financial Times reported, set to be based in London [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
